gate.label: access token
gate.help: Use this access token, kept in this tab alone.

says.token: This server needs its access token. Open the address `serve start` printed, or paste the token here; it is kept in this tab alone.
says.unreachable: The server does not answer: it may have stopped. `femkit serve status` says whether it runs.
says.unreadable: The server answered with something the page cannot read.
